segments.tha-ap515:1.3: Rathiyaṃ paṭipajjantaṃ, kosambaṃ [kosumbaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] adadiṃ tadā.
segments.tha-ap515:2.1: “Ekatiṃse ito kappe, yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā;
segments.tha-ap515:4.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap515:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā kosambaphaliyo thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
